summary: Concorde International Group Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on a U.S. exchange, filed a Form 6-K reporting an August 21, 2026 grant of 85,094 restricted Class A ordinary shares to employees under its 2025 Equity Incentive Plan as consideration for services. Post-issuance, 206,759,450 Class A and 20,311,112 Class B ordinary shares are outstanding. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine equity-compensation disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for dilution and future plan grants.
